plainTranslation: A's growth meets B's dreams. The conjunction fuses them - intense and inseparable.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Imported from project-authored synastry matrix material. Source file was not copied into the repository.
summaryShort: Their confidence, encouragement, and appetite for possibility sit right on top of your imagination, hope, and idealism.
summaryDeep: Their confidence, encouragement, and appetite for possibility sit right on top of your imagination, hope, and idealism. This is one of the closest contacts between you, strong and constant, energizing at its best and a lot to hold at its worst. Let the closeness feed you without letting it run you.
